title: Cooking with Dad
description: Nam cooks a tasty dinner with his dad.
instructions: Read about Nam and his dad. Then choose the right answer.

paragraphs.text: 🍳 On Saturday, Nam cooked dinner with his dad. Nam was very happy because he loves cooking.
First, they went to the shop. They bought rice, eggs, carrots and some chicken. Nam carried the heavy bag home.
Then Dad washed the vegetables and Nam cut the carrots. Dad said, 'You must be careful with the knife.' Nam cut them slowly.
Dad cooked the chicken in a big pan. Nam put the rice in a pot of hot water. It smelled delicious.
After thirty minutes, the food was ready. Nam's mother and his little sister Mai came to the table. They were very hungry.
Everybody liked the dinner. Mai said, 'This is the best chicken in the world!' Nam's face was red and he smiled.
After dinner, Nam washed the plates. Next Saturday, he wants to make a fruit cake.
